convert_fairseq_to_hf_masked_lm: run the script to convert a fairseq RoBERTa checkpoint to a HuggingFace masked language model
convert_fairseq_to_hf_seq_class: run the script to convert a fairseq RoBERTa checkpoint to a HuggingFace sequence classification model
convert_fairseq_to_hf_both: run the script to convert a fairseq checkpoint to both masked LM and sequence classification HuggingFace models
review_save_huggingface_model: review the save_huggingface_model function that saves a remapped state dict as a HuggingFace RoBERTa model
review_key_mapping: review the FAIRSEQ2HF_KEYS mapping lists that define fairseq to HuggingFace parameter name translations
